page.layout: One printed page, title page. Top to bottom, centred: title block in several lines and type sizes; a woodcut ornament of two putti with a laurel wreath below the text; the printer's imprint and date at the foot. Handwritten page number "4" at top right and a library shelf mark at lower left are not printed and are left out.

main_text.l: Ad diem 20. Octobr: horis locoque consuetis.

page.notes: The title is set in several type sizes; the lines above follow the printed line order. The ornament between the date line and the imprint is a woodcut of two winged putti holding a laurel wreath, not text. "Deo" is printed with a circumflex over the o; "Sub" appears as "Su b" with a worn letter. "Doctissimi" and "Publicè" are printed with the long-s and accent forms as shown; the "2" of the date line is printed as "20.". Some letters in the title are worn and may be read imperfectly.
